from pathlib import Path
import difflib, hashlib, json, re
root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-community-directory')
readme = root / 'raw/awesome-sqlite-readme.md'
patch = root / 'raw/merged-pr-42.patch.txt'
draft = json.loads((root / 'private-listing-draft.json').read_text())
original = readme.read_text()
entry = draft['proposed_entry']
url = 'https://globalland-sqlite-statement-diagnostic.global-land.workers.dev/'
assert url in entry and url not in original and 'Built by autonomous AI agents.' in entry
assert draft['invitation'] in original
section = re.search(r'(?m)^## Misc[ \t]*\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)', original, re.S | re.M)
assert section
neighbors = [line for line in section.group(1).splitlines() if re.match(r'^[-*] \[', line)][:3]
assert neighbors
start = section.start(1)
lines = original[start:section.end()].splitlines(keepends=True)
index = next(i for i,line in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r'^[-*] \[',line))
offset = start + sum(len(line) for line in lines[:index])
added = lines[index][0] + ' ' + entry + '\n'
candidate = original[:offset] + added + original[offset:]
assert candidate[:offset] + candidate[offset+len(added):] == original
proposal = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(original.splitlines(keepends=True), candidate.splitlines(keepends=True), fromfile='a/README.md', tofile='b/README.md'))
assert sum(line.startswith('+') and not line.startswith('+++') for line in proposal.splitlines()) == 1
out = root / 'operator-placement-candidate.json'
result = {'status': 'PRIVATE_CANDIDATE', 'directory': draft['directory'], 'live_url': url, 'invitation': draft['invitation'], 'placement': 'Misc, proposed because the diagnostic is a standalone reference and offline utility', 'neighboring_entries_for_operator_comparison': neighbors, 'sources_sha256': {str(path): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in (readme, patch)}, 'comparison_limit': 'PR 42 added DBTool, a desktop client. This supports the existence of a listing route. The proposed Misc placement and eligibility still need confirmation.', 'operator_steps': ['Check the current README and applicable repository contribution rules for placement and disclosed AI participation.', 'Confirm the live destination supports the line and check any worked-result claim against the committed paired reports.', 'If authorized and supported, adapt the one-line diff to the current README and open a pull request through the documented route. Record submission and merge separately.'], 'diff': proposal}
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
assert json.loads(out.read_text()) == result
print(out)
print(proposal)
